status: Exploratory analysis specified after the first absolute-prediction pilot and before examining solvent-contrast scores.
eligible_records: Test records only, paired within the same canonical chromophore and normalized reference DOI. Exclude every chromophore/DOI/solvent group with multiple rows rather than averaging measurements of unknown conditions.
orientation: Solvents sorted by canonical SMILES; contrast is the later solvent minus the earlier solvent.
threshold_interpretation: Operational resolution thresholds for exploratory scoring, not experimentally established significance cutoffs.
dependence: Contrasts reuse measurements and chromophores. Report both record and chromophore macro scores; repeated-seed results are not independent experiments.
chemical_interpretation: Same DOI is an incomplete control for measurement conditions. Opposite quantum-yield and lifetime responses do not independently identify a microscopic relaxation mechanism.
